about_blocks.text: Homewood Health is a Canadian organization that offers mental health and addiction services to help improve the lives of Canadians. With over 130 years of experience, Homewood Health has become a leader in the field, offering a full range of services that are customized to meet the needs of both individuals and organizations. From organizational wellness to recovery management, Homewood Health is dedicated to helping Canadians live healthier, more fulfilling lives through their unique approach to mental health and addiction services.

about_blocks.text: The Unique Continuum of Care at Homewood Health
about_blocks.html: The Unique Continuum of Care at Homewood Health

about_blocks.text: Homewood Health offers the most comprehensive, integrated continuum of services available in Canada. Their unique continuum of care sets them apart from others, offering a range of services that meet the specific needs of individuals, families, and organizations. Homewood’s services include assessments, outpatient and inpatient treatment, recovery management, return to work and family support services. This continuum of care is designed to simplify the process, from diagnosis to treatment and beyond, making it easier for those struggling with mental health or addiction to find the right solutions.
